statement: Ostmann’s inverse Goldbach conjecture. Proves that no finite modification of the primes can be written as $`A+B`$ with $`A,B\subseteq\mathbb Z_{\ge0}`$ each containing at least two elements. This resolves Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture on additive indecomposability.
